# Fullerton Plumbing Referral
> Independent phone-only plumbing referral guide for Fullerton, CA and North Orange County.

## Summary
Fullerton Plumbing Referral provides decision guides and introduces residential and commercial callers to licensed independent plumbing contractors serving Fullerton, CA and surrounding communities.

## Core Services
- Drain Cleaning & Hydro-Jetting: /services/drain-cleaning/
- Sewer Line Inspection & Lateral Repair: /services/sewer-repair/
- Slab & Water Leak Detection: /services/leak-detection/
- Pipe Repair & Water Main Service: /services/pipe-water-line-repair/
- Water Heater Repair & Tankless Installation: /services/water-heaters/
- Fixtures, Faucets & Bathroom Remodel Rough-ins: /services/fixtures-remodel-plumbing/
- Gas Lines & Appliance Piping: /services/gas-line-plumbing/
- Commercial Plumbing & Multi-Family Systems: /services/commercial-plumbing/
- Specialty Plumbing (Treatment, Sump Pumps, Backflow): /services/specialty-plumbing/

## Coverage Areas
- Primary Residential ZIP Codes: 92831, 92832, 92833, 92835
- Fullerton Districts: Downtown/Central, Sunny Hills/North, Amerige Heights/West, East Fullerton/CSUF, Raymond Hills/Golden Hill, South Fullerton/Valencia Mesa
- Neighboring Municipalities: Brea, Placentia, Anaheim, Buena Park, La Habra
